title: Inflammatory Mediators in Erythema Migrans
brief_summary: The main objective of this study is to characterize the inflammatory proteins, gene polymorphisms, and transcriptome profiles in patients with erythema migrans to gain better insight into pathogenesis of early Lyme borreliosis and to define new immune modulators that could serve as biomarkers of disease activity.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* erythema migrans in patients \> 18 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnancy or immunocompromising conditions
* taking antibiotic with antiborrelial activity within 10 days
